planet.name: ROCKtropia
planet.summary: Rock, horror and pop-culture themed planet built by NEVERDIE and run by MindArk since June 2024. It has a daily AI-hunting mission with free weapon and ammo, long zombie and prison mission chains, a new Codex (November 2026), and side areas HELL and Secret Island. Development was thin for years, but MindArk changed creatures, spawns and the Codex in late 2026.
planet.howToReach: New players finish the Setesh tutorial and land on Calypso. From there, fly to ROCKtropia (your own ship or a pilot service), or use Teleportation Tokens: 10 tokens per planet-to-planet trip as of December 2025, 150 kg weight limit. You use them from a planet's main landing teleporter. Once there, use the teleporter map. The drop-down menu also lists HELL.
warnings: Patch 19.12.0 (2026-11-11) added a Codex for all regular ROCKtropia creature groups. New hunting mission chains can no longer be started. Chains you already started can be finished for 6 months, until about mid-May 2027. After that you can finish your current stage but cannot move to the next one. The notes do not say whether the story chains (Boot Camp, National Guard, Police Academy, Prison) count as 'hunting mission chains'. Check in game before you commit.

Most mission details (kill counts, skill rewards, NPC order) come from community copies of the 2016 'Consolidated Rocktropia Guide' thread by Fyrs. A June 2026 community review calls many ROCKtropia chains partly or fully broken. Expect bugs.

19.12.0 renamed some creatures: Horny Little Devil became Happy Little Devil, Sissy became Prison Rookie, Bootylicious became Showstopper, and Voluptuous became Glamorous. Older guides use the old names.

19.12.0 moved the Vixens from the Club NEVERDIE parking lot to nearby hills and made Haters hit harder. 19.12.1 (2026-11-17) made Shy Vixens easier again and Haters slightly weaker. Spawn waypoints from before November 2026 may be wrong.
ROCKtropia, HELL, Secret Island and the old Hunt The THING area each use their own coordinates. A waypoint pasted for the wrong area will not work.

When planet-to-planet token travel launched (18.15.1, 2025-06-17), travel to ROCKtropia was listed as a known issue. A community event post from October 2026 says tokens can be used to get there. No official note saying it was fixed was found.

Small population and a thin local market (community review, June 2026). Plan on carrying loot to other planets to sell. Nothing here is a way to make money. Rocktropia.com's 'monthly wage' figures are marketing, not a promise.

activities.title: Get to ROCKtropia (space or Teleportation Tokens)
activities.summary: There is no free official shuttle confirmed from Setesh to ROCKtropia. The confirmed route is Setesh to Calypso first, then a space trip or a Teleportation Token jump.
steps: Finish the Setesh tutorial, or use the skip terminal. It sends you to Calypso.
Option A: get 10 Teleportation Tokens (crafted, or bought at auction or shops). Weigh 150 kg or less. Use Calypso's main landing teleporter and choose ROCKtropia in the drop-down.
Option B: fly through space in your own ship or with a pilot service. Do not carry stackable loot through lootable space.
On ROCKtropia, open the teleporter map and unlock City of Dreams first. It is the hub for the daily and most early missions.
rewards: Access to ROCKtropia, HELL (teleporter drop-down) and the Secret Island travel agent
requirementsText: 150 kg carry weight or less for token travel

cost.text: 10 Teleportation Tokens per planet-to-planet jump (December 2025 figure), or ship fuel and pilot fees. Token market price not sourced.
cost.markupNote: Tokens are a crafted item sold by players; price varies.

activities.limits: 150 kg weight limit for token travel.

score.rationale: Needed for everything else. Token cost is the main hurdle for a new player.

warnings: rocktropia.com says Setesh has a shuttle straight to ROCKtropia. Official forum threads from December 2025 to March 2026 only describe leaving Setesh for Calypso. Treat the direct shuttle as unconfirmed.
Token travel to Rocktropia was a known issue when it launched in June 2025. An October 2026 event post says it now works.

activities.title: The AI War (daily, free weapon and ammo)
activities.summary: ROCKtropia's main daily mission. Kill 40 AI creatures, which spawn while Vixens and some other mobs are being fought near Club NEVERDIE. The mission gives you a weapon and Cheap A$$ Ammo, so a newcomer can do it with no gear.
steps: Talk to the mission giver outside Club NEVERDIE in City of Dreams and accept The AI War.
Go to the Shy Vixens near the club. Since 19.12.0 they are on the hills next to the old parking lot.
Pull or hunt Vixens until the yellow AI appear. Some players lure Vixens into the club turrets to save ammo.
Use the Cheap A$$ Ammo only on the AI so you do not run out. Kill 40 and hand in.
rewards: Presidential 2 PED credit card (sell to the trade terminal for 2 PED)
Presidential Pay Stub (its old RockBucks payout is historical)

cost.text: Weapon and ammo supplied. You may spend your own ammo on Vixens to make AI spawn, or if the supplied ammo runs out.
cost.markupNote: The credit card is worth its TT value.

currencies.name: Cheap A$$ Ammo
currencies.note: Mission ammo for the supplied weapon. One source lists 10,000 units (about 1 PED TT).

currencies.name: Presidential Pay Stub
currencies.note: Used to count toward a yearly RockBucks payout under NEVERDIE. Probably did not survive the MindArk takeover.

cooldown.resetNote: EntropiaCentral says it 'repeats daily'; rocktropia.com says it 'resets every 24 hours'. The exact timer start was not sourced, so the app counts 24 hours from when you mark it done.

locations.label: AI War mission giver at City of Dreams / Club NEVERDIE (named Presidential Recruiter or Sanctioned Weapons Dealer, depending on the source)

score.rationale: Small daily TT reward with free ammo. The best zero-cost daily on the planet.

warnings: Sources give the giver different names and give different reward lists, so check the in-game text.

19.12.0 moved the Vixens. 19.12.1 (2026-11-17) restored AI spawns near the moved Vixens so the mission can progress again. If no AI spawn, AI are also reported near Thieves, Thugs, Hustlers and Zombie Biker Prospects.

activities.title: Zero-PED start: oil, sweat and Motorhead kegs
activities.summary: A June 2026 video showed a from-scratch start on ROCKtropia with no deposit. It picked up oil at the docks, sweated Haters, and collected kegs at Motorhead Stadium, which sold above TT. The amounts are small, but this pays for your first ammo.
steps: Pick up oil at the docks. Wait 5-10 minutes between runs so it can respawn.
Sweat Haters (or Mulholland Boys) with the free sweating tool. Haters have unusually large sweat pools.
Pick up kegs around Motorhead Stadium. The creator saw them sell at about 160% of TT.
Sell everything, buy ammo, then do The AI War daily and beginner hunts.
rewards: Small amounts of PED from oil and sweat (the video made about 8.6 PED total in part one)
Evader, Mindforce and other skill gains from sweating
requirementsText: Free sweating tool from the starter kit

cost.markupNote: The video creator saw kegs at about 160% of TT and sold sweat at about 1.4 PED per 1,000 bottles. These are one person's prices from June 2026.

activities.limits: Oil and kegs respawn slowly and other players may compete for them.

locations.label: ROCKtropia docks (oil) and Motorhead Stadium (kegs). No waypoints given in the source.

score.rationale: Free but slow. Useful only to get your first few PED.

warnings: 19.12.0 made Haters hit harder (players reported around 25 damage). 19.12.1 cut Hater damage slightly. Sweating them with no armor may now be risky.
Level 76 humanoid street mobs stand just north of the Tangerine Shops. Pressing F near them can pull aggro (June 2026 report).

activities.title: Beginner hunting: Shy Vixens, Forum Trolls, Thieves
activities.summary: ROCKtropia has many 2-60 HP creatures near City of Dreams and Old/New Harlem. They suit a TT pistol, the Frontier starter gear or a shortblade. 19.12.1 made Shy Vixens beginner-friendly again.
steps: 2-20 HP: Forum Trolls, ROCKtropians, Thieves and Thugs in the Harlem streets, plus Shy Vixens (10 HP versions).
30-40 HP: Hustlers and Pissed Off Cops in Old/New Harlem.
50-60 HP: 50 HP Vixen types, Soulshakers on the hill near City of Dreams, Young Daikiba and Zombie Biker Prospects.
Check the new ROCKtropia Codex categories (Thugs, Street Life, Forum Trolls) so your kills count toward Codex ranks.
rewards: Loot, skill gains and Codex progress

cost.text: Your own ammo and decay. Mixed 10 HP and 50 HP Vixens need different weapons.
cost.markupNote: Most generic ROCKtropia loot has little markup (June 2026 review).

locations.label: Shy Vixens: HISTORICAL spot at the old Club NEVERDIE parking lot. Not a current pin; 19.12.0 moved the Vixens to the nearby hills, so no waypoint is given.

score.rationale: Cheap low-HP targets close to the hub. They also feed the new Codex.

warnings: The Entropia Codex page was written before the 19.12.0 spawn changes. Old Harlem spawns and Bank Robbers were rebalanced in 19.12.1, so expect differences.

activities.title: ROCKtropia Codex (new November 2026)
activities.summary: Since 19.12.0 (2026-11-11), all regular ROCKtropia creature groups have a Codex. This replaces the old per-creature hunting mission chains as the long-term skill-reward track. 19.12.1 added Forum Trolls and Street Life challenges, Hater progression, Panther Puny in ROCKtropia Wildlife, and Old Harlem Thugs and Bonzo in the Thugs Codex.
steps: Open the Codex in game and check the ROCKtropia categories.
Hunt the creatures listed in a category to rank it up.
Choose your skill reward at each rank.
rewards: Codex rank rewards (skill rewards). Exact amounts were not in the sources.

cost.text: Ammo and decay from normal hunting.

locations.label: Codex window in game (not a place)

score.rationale: Long-term skill track that now replaces the old mission chains. The cost is normal hunting cost.

warnings: Launch-day players reported mobs reacting with a delay and the Codex not showing (2026-11-11). 19.12.1 fixed related challenges. Check that kills count.

activities.title: Old creature mission chains (closing: finish by about May 2027)
activities.summary: ROCKtropia had about 30 per-creature kill-point chains with large skill rewards. Examples: Kool Kat 'The Lawn You Keep', Old Wolves 'Diesel in Distress', Motorhead Royalty 'The Revenge of Montose', and the Muscle Beach workouts. Since 19.12.0 you cannot start new hunting mission chains. Chains already started can be finished for 6 months.
steps: Check your mission log for ROCKtropia hunting chains you already started.
Finish them before about 2027-05-11, six months after 19.12.0. After that you can only finish the stage you are on.
Workout missions: the 5LB Dumbbells (Thieves) mission blocks the other Muscle Beach workouts until you finish or abandon it.
rewards: Kool Kat stages: 15.8 PED up to 82.48 PED of skills per stage
Motorhead Royalty stage V: 100 Stamina tokens plus a skill reward of up to 157.29 PED
Atrox 120 Pound Workout stage VI: 1 Stamina token plus a skill choice
requirementsText: Chain must already be started before 2026-11-11

cost.text: Thousands of kill points of ammo and decay per stage.

currencies.name: Stamina token
currencies.note: Reward from some workout and Motorhead chains. Its use is not described in the sources.

activities.limits: No new starts since 2026-11-11. Six-month window to advance existing chains.

locations.label: Castle Gatekeepers (Motorhead Security/Royalty) next to Lemmy's castle teleporter

score.rationale: Big skill rewards, but only if you already started. Very long grinds.

warnings: Reward figures come from a community copy of 2016 data and may have changed.
Several chains (for example the Secret Island market missions) are recorded as broken.

activities.title: Cellphone errand at Noobs Noobs Noobs club
activities.summary: A no-combat talking errand that gets you a cellphone. The cellphone unlocks several repeatable missions and leads into The Road to War. There is no mission tracker, so do the steps in order.
steps: Go to the Noobs Noobs Noobs club, south-east of the Hyperplex teleporter. Talk to Big Boy.
Talk to Tipsy Tony, then Lying Larry in the pawnshop next door, then Big Boy again.
Get a gold coin from Gus at the petrol station. Go back to Big Boy, then to Gus for a glam ingot, and give the ingot to Big Boy.
Head east toward Boris the Bum. Search the marked dumpster, give Boris the smokes, and bring the ROCKtropia record to Big Boy.
Get a cocktail from Tiffany on the dance floor and give it to Cynthia. She gives you the cellphone.
rewards: ROCKtropia record (also needed for Kristi's Hater mission)

locations.label: Hyperplex teleporter (club is south-east of it)

score.rationale: Free, quick, and opens the planet's main story chains.

warnings: Data traces back to the 2016 consolidated guide. NPCs may not respond if the scripting is broken (see the June 2026 review).

activities.title: The Road to War (walk to BAMF HQ)
activities.summary: A 13-leg walking mission from Lt. Funk to Drill Sgt. Breakerz at BAMF HQ in Zomhattan. It unlocks the Boot Camp zombie chain and the Police Academy.
steps: Talk to Lt. Funk south of City of Dreams.
Follow the legs: through the cave, along the main road, through New Harlem Studios, to the docks, across the water to the Zomhattan coast, and up to BAMF HQ.
One leg's map marker (crossing the water) is reported as wrong. Follow the coordinates instead.
Finish at Drill Sgt. Breakerz.
rewards: Unlocks Boot Camp and Police Academy
requirementsText: Enough armor or speed to cross zombie areas in Zomhattan

cost.text: Walking only; you may take damage from zombies.

score.rationale: Free gateway to Police Academy (which unlocks the daily police calls) and the zombie chain.

activities.title: Police Academy I-III (get the Police Radio)
activities.summary: Three short hunting missions: 50 Forum Trolls, then 100 Soul Shakers, then 300 Soul Shakers. Graduating gives the ROCKtropia Police Radio and Officer status, which turn on the daily police calls.
steps: After The Road to War, take Police Academy I from Lt. Funk: kill 50 Forum Trolls.
Police Academy II: kill 100 Soul Shakers.
Police Academy III from Cpt. Shramsky: kill 300 Soul Shakers.
Keep the Police Radio in your inventory.
rewards: Small skill rewards (about 0.05 PED each for stages I-II)
requirementsText: Weapon able to kill 50-60 HP Soulshakers

cost.text: Ammo and decay for about 450 low-level kills.

score.rationale: Cheap targets, and it unlocks a repeatable daily.

warnings: Could be affected by 19.12.0's stop on new hunting mission chains. Check that Lt. Funk still offers it.
Sources disagree on the giver: EntropiaCentral's overview says Lt. Funk gives all three, while its Police Academy III page names Cpt. Shramsky.

activities.title: Daily police calls (10-57, 10-66, 11-25)
activities.summary: Repeatable kill missions that only start if your ROCKtropia Police Radio is in your inventory. Examples: Police Call 10-57 (40 Mulholland Boys), 10-66 (60 Stereo Jackers), and 11-25 (from Mobile Mike).
steps: Carry the Police Radio, not inside a container.
Pick up the calls: 11-25 from Mobile Mike, 10-57 and 10-66 at their points on the map.
If a call will not activate, get the radio repaired at Mobile Mike in City of Dreams.
rewards: Rewards were not given in the sources

cost.text: Your own ammo and decay. Mulholland Boys are tougher than beginner mobs.

activities.limits: One completion per call per cooldown.

cooldown.resetNote: EntropiaCentral lists Police Call 10-57 as 'repeatable every 24 hours'. The other calls are assumed to be the same, but this was not sourced.

score.rationale: Repeatable target for hunting you might do anyway. Rewards are unknown.

warnings: Rewards are not documented. Mulholland Boys can hurt solo players.

activities.title: Bar Job - Making Bank At The Bar (hourly)
activities.summary: A beginner guide mentions an hourly mission from Alia linked to the Thug and Thief spawns in Harlem. Only one source mentions it.
steps: Talk to Alia at the bar.
Do the objective (the source ties it to Thieves/Thugs; L4 Thugs without a name do not count).
Hand in and repeat after an hour.

cost.text: Ammo for low-HP Thieves and Thugs.

score.rationale: Cheap repeatable add-on next to beginner mobs. Details are unclear.

warnings: Only one undated source. Objective and reward not confirmed.

activities.title: Snake Hunting Contracts (1-hour repeat)
activities.summary: Suzy McSnaketrader inside the Dragon Head pub gives snake contracts (Green, Brown, Purple snake) with skill rewards. Each can be repeated after a 1-hour wait.
steps: Go to Suzy McSnaketrader inside the Dragon Head pub.
Take a contract and kill the listed snakes.
Hand in. The same contract is available again after 1 hour.

cooldown.resetNote: Source: 'Each mission is repeatable after a 1 hour wait'.

score.rationale: Short repeatable skill top-up, if it still runs.

warnings: These may count as hunting missions that 19.12.0 closed to new starts. Not confirmed either way.

activities.title: Boot Camp (zombie kills, B.A.M.F radio)
activities.summary: Five zombie-kill missions from Drill Sgt. Breakerz in Zomhattan: 50, 100, 500, 5,000 and 10,000 kills. The last one gives the B.A.M.F Tactical Radio, which the National Guard chain needs.
steps: After The Road to War, take Boot Camp 1 from Drill Sgt. Breakerz.
Kill zombies in Zomhattan (Zombie Biker Prospects are the easiest). Read each completion text for the next NPC.
Finish Boot Camp 5 (10,000 zombies).
rewards: Small skill rewards (0.06 to 5.29 PED per stage)

cost.text: About 15,650 zombie kills of ammo and decay.
cost.markupNote: Zombies can drop Rotten Bananas, the ticket to Secret Island.

currencies.name: Rotten Banana
currencies.note: Zombie loot, used to travel to Secret Island.

score.rationale: Small skill rewards for a very long grind. Mainly a gate to later content.

warnings: May fall under 19.12.0's stop on new hunting mission chains. Confirm Breakerz still offers Boot Camp 1.

activities.title: National Guard (zombie chain, late)
activities.summary: Six zombie-kill missions from 1,000 up to 15,000 kills, with growing skill rewards (Aim 19.31 PED on 'The Advance'). Your B.A.M.F radio must be working and at the top level of your inventory.
steps: Talk to the National Guard Operations Officer near BAMF HQ.
If Bruiser at FOXTROT Company will not talk, visit Cpt. ECHO Company first.
Before the final kill of each mission, move the radio to the top level of your inventory. Otherwise the mission may bug.
If NPCs will not give missions, get the radio repaired at Mobile Mike.

cost.text: Tens of thousands of zombie kills.

score.rationale: Late grind with modest skill rewards.

warnings: May fall under 19.12.0's stop on new hunting mission chains.

activities.title: No Way Out prison chain and The Great Escape (+1 Strength)
activities.summary: A four-tier prison chain of about 40,000 kills, including PvP objectives in tiers 1-2. It ends with The Great Escape, which gives 1 Strength (an attribute point), a Company cellphone, keys, and the Top Secret Company files needed for Company missions.
steps: Get arrested: take the lockpick from the dumpster at 135427, 88116. Go to the Tangerine teleporter, then the building at 134340, 83450. Enter any combination in the upstairs safe and kill the police that come.
Do the tiers in order (13, 9, 8 and 7 missions). Talking to the wrong NPC or entering wrong areas can be fatal. Leaving mid-chain adds a 200-kill 'snitch' penalty.
Tier 3: a wrong dialogue answer adds 50 yard kills. Tier 4: do not kill a S.O.R.T officer during the 10,000-inmate Mamba Mutiny stage.
The Great Escape: Warden's office, shed, water tower, a 10,000-kill riot, roof, lighthouse, docks, 2 x 100 Crunk Sharks, then the beach crate on the small island with code 5879.
rewards: Top Secret Company files folder (unlocks Company missions)
Yard workouts pay items such as gold coins and Teleman coin blueprints

cost.text: About 40,000 kills plus the escape riot.

locations.label: Arrest start: dumpster at 135427, 88116; Tangerine teleporter at 134411, 83613 (coordinates only, no /wp form in source)

score.rationale: Rare attribute reward and access to late Company content, but a huge grind with PvP steps.

warnings: The 70lb Dumbbell yard workout is recorded as bugged.
May fall under 19.12.0's stop on new hunting mission chains. 19.12.0 also renamed the 'Sissy' maturity to 'Prison Rookie'.

activities.title: The Cure: Company Issued Zombie Vaccine
activities.summary: After the prison escape, the Medical Officer in the Company Safe House asks for 50,000 points of intelligent zombie kills. The reward vaccine gives access to infected and contaminated zombies, and it can be traded to the Rogue Trader for a Mindkey.
steps: Talk to the Medical Officer in the Company Safe House.
Score 50,000 points: Prospects 1, Enforcers 2, Decomposing 3, Nomads 4, Outlaws 5.
Optional: give the vaccine to the Rogue Trader in the Chelsea building penthouse for a Mindkey (reported to start Virus Kong waves in HELL).

cost.text: 10,000 to 50,000 zombie kills depending on type.
cost.markupNote: The vaccine is tradeable; no price sourced.

locations.label: Medical Officer, Company Safe House (no waypoint given)

score.rationale: End-game access item for dedicated zombie hunters.

warnings: The Mindkey effect is reported, not confirmed. Very old data.

activities.title: Claimable plots near Club NEVERDIE (plot tokens from loot)
activities.summary: 19.12.0 (2026-11-11) added claimable plots near Club NEVERDIE. Plot tokens drop from creature loot anywhere on ROCKtropia. The same patch added four constructible plot homes.
steps: Hunt any ROCKtropia creatures and watch for a plot token in your loot.
Use the token to claim one of the new plots near Club NEVERDIE.
Optionally build one of the new plot homes (Colonist Residence, Terrace, Tower, Grand Residence).
requirementsText: A plot token (loot drop or bought from players)

cost.text: Normal hunting until a token drops, or the market price of a token. Building costs differ by home type.

currencies.name: ROCKtropia plot token
currencies.note: Drops in creature loot all over ROCKtropia; spent to claim a plot.

activities.limits: Token drop rate and number of plots not stated.

locations.label: Near Club NEVERDIE, City of Dreams

score.rationale: A new long-term housing unlock that comes from normal hunting.

warnings: Released 15 days before this review. Token names, drop rates and plot rules are not documented yet.

activities.title: Lockpick instances: zombie sewers, crib and booty raids, werewolf mines
activities.summary: ROCKtropia has solo and team instances that need Lockpick Kits of rising tiers: zombie sewers (I-III and up), crib raids (III-V), booty raids (IV-VI) and werewolf mines (V-VIII). Team versions are said to loot better.
steps: Craft Lockpick Kits from blueprints (they use potions such as Faith, Focus and Patience) or buy them from players.
Pick an instance for your kit tier, for example Union Station Subway for sewers.
In sewers, watch the 'noise level' timers, which trigger horde attacks. For crib raids, right-click doors and choose 'operate' to plant explosives.

cost.text: Kit cost plus ammo and decay.

currencies.name: Lockpick Kit
currencies.note: Entry item for each instance tier.

activities.limits: Some instances have cooldowns between runs (length not given).

cooldown.resetNote: Source only says 'Some instances have cooldown periods between runs'.

score.rationale: Varied mid-level content, but kits add cost and status is unverified.

warnings: Undated community page. No 2025-2026 run reports found. Some raids sit in PvP zones.

activities.title: Restored monster truck blueprints (crafting)
activities.summary: 19.9.0 (2026-06-24) restored ROCKtropia monster truck, wheel and chainsaw blueprints that had been removed by mistake. A player confirmed the monster truck and wheel blueprints came back.
steps: Check your blueprint book for the monster truck and wheel blueprints.
